descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'Yahweh has established', referring to a Levitical official in charge of tithes and offerings under King Hezekiah (2 Chr 31:12-13) and possibly also a Levitical chief during Josiah's Passover (2 Chr 35:9). The variant spellings Kananyahu and Konanyahu are orthographic alternations of the same name. All grammatical forms — nominative and with conjunction (and-Conaniah) — represent the same proper noun. Multilingual evidence confirms: eng 'Conaniah', spa 'Kananyahu/Konanyahu', hin 'kananyahu' (कनन्याहू), arb 'Kananya/Kunaniya' (كَنَنْيَا/كُونَنْيَا), kor 'Konanya' (코난야), swa 'Ishiya' (local adaptation).
